# Alpenglow Adventure Sports

> > Outdoor gear retailer specializing in winter sports, avalanche safety equipment, climbing gear, and guided mountain instruction in the Northeast.

Alpenglow Adventure Sports offers premium outdoor equipment from brands like Osprey, MSR, Mammut, and Backcountry Access, alongside AIARE avalanche courses and guided adventures through Acadia Mountain Guides. The shop serves backcountry skiers, climbers, and hikers with both retail products and professional instruction.

## Avalanche Safety Equipment

- [Alpenglow Adventure Sports: Gear to Go!](https://alpenglowgear.com): Homepage featuring avalanche safety gear including the Soelden Pro Avy 32 Airbag, Barryvox 2 Tour 280 Package, and Beta Snow Science Saw for backcountry winter sports

## Winter Sports & Snowsports Gear

- [Alpenglow Adventure Sports: Gear to Go!](https://alpenglowgear.com): Winter sports equipment and snowsports gear from leading brands for backcountry skiing and mountaineering

## Climbing Equipment

- [Alpenglow Adventure Sports: Gear to Go!](https://alpenglowgear.com): Climbing gear from E9, OCUN, and CAMP, including the Geko Ice Pro Glove for ice climbing and alpine pursuits

## Hiking & Camping Gear

- [Alpenglow Adventure Sports: Gear to Go!](https://alpenglowgear.com): Hiking equipment including Oboz footwear with O FIT System, Osprey backpacks, and MSR camping gear

## Guided Instruction & Adventure Courses

- [Alpenglow Adventure Sports: Gear to Go!](https://alpenglowgear.com): AIARE avalanche courses and guided mountain adventures through Acadia Mountain Guides
